sections.title: Four steps to move forward with direction.
sections.lead: The project moves forward with concrete decisions about offer, structure, content, publishing, and initial follow-up.

cards.title: 1. Understand the business
cards.description: We review what you sell, who you serve, what questions your customer has, and how people contact you today.

cards.title: 2. Define the structure
cards.description: We organize pages, sections, and messages so each visitor finds what they need.

cards.title: 3. Produce the site
cards.description: We create pages and components with clear content to review and adjust with you.

cards.title: 4. Publish and adjust
cards.description: We review mobile and desktop, refine details, and leave the base ready to collect first-party interest data.

faq.title: How the project is handled
faq.lead: Answers focused on the creation process and guidance.

items.title: What do you deliver in the service?
items.content: A website with structure, commercial copy, responsive design, WhatsApp contact, and initial reading of first-party interaction data.

items.title: Do you help organize my ideas?
items.content: Yes. We start from your offer and turn it into pages, sections, and messages that a person can understand quickly.

items.title: Can I move forward in stages?
items.content: Yes. We define a useful first version and leave a clear route to expand content, sectors, or campaigns later.

items.title: What should I prepare?
items.content: Services, service area, differentiators, available photos, visual references, and ideal way to receive inquiries.

final.title: Tell us what you sell and what you want to achieve with your website.
final.lead: We help you choose scope, pages, content, and data signals worth measuring according to your business stage.
